title: Flow states
comment: Journal v3 design of record. Static states use the closed component inventory and lock.css.

caption.title: Voice memo / pending
caption.text: Compact Transport. Native browser permission; inline recovery. Stop and keep returns directly to the journal.

caption.title: Voice memo / denied
caption.text: Compact Transport. Native browser permission; inline recovery. Stop and keep returns directly to the journal.

caption.title: Voice memo / missing
caption.text: Compact Transport. Native browser permission; inline recovery. Stop and keep returns directly to the journal.

caption.title: Voice memo / recording
caption.text: Compact Transport. The waveform is a fixed decorative shape; it does not follow the sound. Stop and keep returns directly to the journal.

caption.title: Voice memo / paused
caption.text: Compact Transport. Native browser permission; inline recovery. Stop and keep returns directly to the journal.

caption.title: Voice memo / draft
caption.text: Compact Transport. Leaving keeps a paused memo as the one draft on this device; the mic and Today's Continue line open it.

caption.title: Voice memo / discard
caption.text: Compact Transport. Discard asks first; Discard memo returns to Today with nothing kept.

caption.title: Recording kept · {dir}
caption.text: Journal v3 review state. The action and recovery use existing fields, rows, notices and buttons. This static file illustrates the state; V3-REVISION.md specifies behavior.
